adaptations: The native Vuetify tree is generated by executing the fixed get_form method with an empty service inventory. At runtime, the Go worker fills the media-server options from the host SDK and returns the separate source model with enabled=false and delay=0.
Consume the standard transfer.complete event. Preserve the source transfer target path and media title, year, type, and category when constructing the host refresh item.

Use the existing media.servers.list and media.servers.refresh SDK methods for server discovery, connection checks, item refresh, and root refresh. Select the refresh behavior from the service type exposed by the host.
The current host exposes its existing configured fnOS slot. The plugin consumes that slot through the SDK while keeping media server configuration in its existing host location.
scope: Native form and source provenance. Worker behavior and actual host acceptance are tracked in the migration ledger.
